annotation.evidence_span: no other frame processing between values
annotation.interpretation_a: All other frame processing must be paused while a SETTINGS frame is being processed, value by value.
annotation.interpretation_b: Only processing of *new* SETTINGS frames must be paused while a SETTINGS frame is being processed, value by value; other frame types can continue to be processed.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'no other frame processing' is open to interpretation. Does it mean *all* frame processing must halt until the SETTINGS frame is fully processed, or only the processing of other SETTINGS frames? This impacts how an endpoint handles concurrent frames.
annotation.missing_information: It is unclear whether 'other frame processing' refers to all frames, or only to other SETTINGS frames. The scope of 'other frame processing' needs to be clarified.
